provenance.notes: Every task text was written for this dataset. No user data, memory, conversation history, attachment or secret is included; credential-shaped strings are fabricated and marked FAKE where the format allows. Labels were fixed before any Jev prediction existed, and acceptable alternatives were recorded at labeling time.

full.description: Every built-in tool, balanced approval policy, default limits.

chat_only.description: No retrieval, workspace, action or delegation tools.

no_retrieval.description: Workspace tools only; no web search or fetch.

write_only.description: Commands and writes but no read tool.

deny_external.description: Every built-in tool; the approval policy denies external tools.

tight_limits.description: Every built-in tool with a one-turn limit.
